Vibroblade Combat Styles

Choose Vibroblade for attacks that scale with defense and draw enemy attention, or for nearby area damage.

Vibroblade - Bulwark

Bulwark includes a strike based on your Physical Defense and attacks that increase enmity toward you.

Vibroblade - Frenzy

Frenzy includes next-hit attacks and nearby area damage.
